name: skiils
description: One-paragraph description of what this project does.
conventions: All components use named exports, never default exports
API routes are in /app/api/**/*.ts using Next.js Route Handlers
Zod schemas for all external input validation
All agent skills must adhere to the AgentSkills.io open standard: strictly scripts/, examples/, resources/ subdirectories (never evals/ or assets/)
Skill descriptions must strictly follow formula: <third-person capability>. <trigger contexts and keywords>. <explicit exclusions>.

Skill bodies must follow the 9-part structure: Scope -> Preflight -> Procedure (with explicit gates) -> Decisions table -> Output contract -> Verification -> Stop and escalate -> Anti-patterns -> Examples/References
architecture_patterns: Server Components for data fetching, Client Components for interactivity only
never_do: Never use useEffect for data fetching — use React Server Components
Never store secrets in environment files committed to git
Never use inline styles — always use Tailwind classes
Never use any TypeScript type — always type explicitly
Never instantiate THREE objects (Vector3, Color, Matrix4, etc.) inside requestAnimationFrame or useFrame — always pre-allocate outside the loop
Never set renderer.setPixelRatio above 2 — always cap with Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2)
Never ship a Three.js scene without calling .dispose() on all geometries, materials, and textures on unmount
Never use separate meshes for repeated identical objects — always use THREE.InstancedMesh or THREE.Points
Never build a 3D scene without checking renderer.info.render.calls — must stay within draw call budget

Never configure ioredis with maxRetriesPerRequest: null without also setting connectTimeout, lazyConnect: true, and retryStrategy: () => null. This causes every Redis command to hang indefinitely when Redis is unreachable, permanently freezing the MCP server.
Never call Redis commands (smembers, keys, get, etc.) without first checking isRedisAvailable(). All tools must degrade gracefully to SQLite-only mode when Redis is unreachable.
Never pass --watchAll to vitest in automated validation; always use --run --passWithNoTests
Never throw unhandled errors when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is missing; always fall back gracefully to HeuristicJevAsker
Never use purple-to-indigo gradients, purple glowing cards, or generic AI-slop color palettes on websites
Never use pill-shaped buttons (rounded-full) for primary landing page buttons or CTAs (use structured rounded-md or rounded-lg)
Never use fake reviews, fabricated testimonials, or AI-generated avatar photos
Never display fake metrics, unsubstantiated statistics, or fabricated customer counter tickers
Never write vague hero section titles (e.g. 'Empower your workflow with AI synergies') — always write concrete value propositions explaining the product in sentence one
Never use emojis as UI icons or bullet icons — always use vector SVG icons (Lucide, Heroicons, Radix)
Never use em dashes (—) repeatedly in marketing and website copy
Never use crazy scroll-jacking animations, tumbling card reveals, or custom laggy cursor follower animations
Never use generic 3D glossy clay figures or AI-generated stock photography
Never generate AI slop marketing filler — keep copy crisp, concise, and human-written
Never leave 'Made with AI', 'Built with v0', or default AI platform tags in production web applications
Never output verbose unsolicited recaps, exhaustive changelogs, or repetitive summaries that waste tokens — mention ONLY the most critical points unless explicitly asked
preferred_patterns: Practice extreme token economy: keep responses concise, high-signal, and directly answer user requests without unprompted changelogs or filler
Use Zod for all schema validation
Use Drizzle ORM for all database access
Use server actions for mutations
Use fast-jev decision-based compaction (fast_jev_compact / compactTranscript) for conversation history compression rather than lossy LLM summarization
Pass state between skills via persistent file artifacts at documented paths, never chat memory
Use WorktreeManager (manage_worktree / ase-init --worktree) for isolated workspace branches during parallel tasks or experimental subagents without dirtying the working copy
Use TranscriptReader (read_native_transcript / ase-init --transcript) for zero-overhead streaming log ingestion directly from disk without PTY scrapers or background daemons
Always mandate production web essentials: custom domain, custom favicon suite (SVG/ICO/Apple Touch), and complete OpenGraph metadata
Always remove all 'Made with AI' tags, badges, and builder watermarks before shipping
Always include dedicated, accessible Privacy Policy (/privacy) and Terms & Conditions (/terms) pages
Always use real product screenshots, live code samples, or honest zero-state displays rather than fake social proof
Always follow the anti-vibe-design skill guidelines for all frontend, web design, and UI/UX tasks
For 3D: always use powerPreference: 'high-performance' in WebGLRenderer
For 3D: always use ACESFilmicToneMapping + SRGBColorSpace on the renderer
For 3D: use UnrealBloomPass or @react-three/postprocessing Bloom for all glowing effects
For 3D: use getGPUTier() from detect-gpu to serve adaptive quality levels
For 3D: use GSAP ScrollTrigger with scrub:1.5 for cinematic scroll-driven animation
For 3D shaders: use /* glsl */ template literal tags for syntax highlighting
For 3D assets: always run optimize-3d-assets.sh before adding any .glb to /public
sprint_focus: Building the user onboarding flow with email verification and profile setup.
